<a id="toccata_and_funk"></a>
## Bach as Hard Funk: `toccata_and_funk.yml`

Toccata and funk: Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D minor (BWV 565) played by a funk band of the late
seventies, in the manner of The Pride (The Isley Brothers, from Go for Your Guns). Every note of the
organ, the lead guitars, the clavinet in the fugue and the bass under the pedal entries is Bach's,
at Bach's pitch and place in the bar; the drums, the bass riff and the clavinet's chanks are new.
The first flourish is the organ alone, then the groove; the second and third flourishes land on the
beat; a fuzz guitar takes the fugue's subject and the clavinet its countersubject; the pedal's solo
entry is the bass alone over the kick; Bach's last chords end it.
